description: uv project scaffolding, quality-gate config, settings + mode resolution, and secret-safe structured logging. Establishes the buildable foundation every later feature depends on. Must be first; FEAT-002..006 depend on it.
steps: Create pyproject.toml with requires-python >=3.11: core deps fastapi==0.115.6, uvicorn[standard]==0.34.0, pydantic==2.10.4, pydantic-settings==2.7.1, langgraph==1.0.8, numpy==2.2.1; a dev group with ruff==0.8.4, mypy==1.14.0, pytest==8.3.4, pytest-asyncio==0.25.0, httpx==0.28.1; optional extras openrouter (tensorzero==2025.11.1, httpx), redis (redis==5.2.1), postgres (psycopg[binary]==3.2.3), bedrock (boto3==1.35.90, botocore==1.35.90), pdf (fpdf2==2.8.1), redteam (pyrit==0.8.1). Put ruff lint+format config, mypy config, and pytest config (asyncio_mode=auto, testpaths) in pyproject.toml. No comments anywhere. If a pin fails at uv lock, bump to nearest compatible patch/minor and record it in findings; never change majors.

Create .python-version containing 3.11, a comment-free .gitignore (ignore .venv, __pycache__, *.pyc, uv build caches; do NOT ignore uv.lock), and .env.example listing only placeholder env var names (QUERYN_* plus REDIS_URL, DATABASE_URL, LANGCHAIN_*, AWS_*, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, QUERYN_OPENROUTER_MODEL) with placeholder-or-empty values and no real secrets.
Create app/__init__.py, tests/__init__.py, tests/unit/__init__.py so packages import.

Create app/config.py: a pydantic-settings Settings model (env-prefixed QUERYN_ plus well-known names) and pure deterministic mode resolution computed once, matching design.md Configuration section: llm mock unless QUERYN_LLM_PROVIDER=openrouter AND OPENROUTER_API_KEY set AND QUERYN_OPENROUTER_MODEL non-empty (missing model id raises a configuration error, never defaults a model); stm redis-if-reachable else memory; ltm pgvector-if-reachable else memory; guardrail bedrock-if-configured else local; tracing langsmith-if-configured else local (or noop if QUERYN_TRACING=noop); max_verify_retries default 2; cache similarity threshold default 0.95; pdf_enabled from a guarded import fpdf. The resolved-mode map is typed dict[str, str | bool] with pdf_enabled stored as a native bool under exactly that key.

Create app/observability/__init__.py and app/observability/logging.py: JSON structured logging via the logging module plus a redaction filter that masks any value whose key matches *_api_key, *_token, password, authorization, database_url, redis_url and any sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,} token. No secret is ever written.

Create tests/unit/test_config.py and tests/unit/test_logging.py covering: default resolution is mock/memory/local with pdf_enabled a bool; openrouter requested without model id raises a config error; redaction masks secret-keyed and sk- shaped values.
acceptance_criteria: uv sync --extra pdf resolves dependencies and writes uv.lock
uv run ruff check . and uv run ruff format --check . pass
uv run pytest tests/unit/test_config.py tests/unit/test_logging.py passes
uv run mypy app/config.py app/observability/logging.py reports no errors
No file created in this feature contains a comment or docstring
findings: Version bump: fpdf2 pinned to 2.8.2 instead of 2.8.1. Reason: pyrit==0.8.1 (redteam extra) requires fpdf2>=2.8.2, so the 2.8.1 pin made the pdf and redteam extras mutually unsatisfiable at uv lock. Bumped to the nearest compatible patch (2.8.2, same minor, no major change). Later features should use fpdf2==2.8.2. Implementation notes: Settings (pydantic-settings) uses field aliases (QUERYN_ prefix plus well-known names OPENROUTER_API_KEY/REDIS_URL/DATABASE_URL/LANGCHAIN_*/AWS_*); construct in tests via alias kwargs. resolve_modes() returns dict[str, str | bool] with keys llm/stm/ltm/guardrail/tracing (str) and pdf_enabled (native bool). openrouter requested without a model id raises ConfigurationError (never defaults a model); openrouter without api key falls back to mock. STM/LTM here resolve to the service name when REDIS_URL/DATABASE_URL are set, else memory; actual connection-ping reachability and in-memory fallback are deferred to the memory factory in later features (startup wiring). pdf_enabled computed via importlib.util.find_spec('fpdf') to avoid an import-untyped mypy error and keep it a pure resolved bool. get_settings() is lru_cache'd. observability/logging.py: JsonFormatter reads record.extra_fields (a dict) for structured fields; RedactionFilter masks keys matching *_api_key/*_token/password/authorization/database_url/redis_url and any sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,} value in msg, tuple/dict args, and extra_fields; configure_logging() installs a single JSON StreamHandler on root. Gate results (all pass): uv sync --extra pdf wrote uv.lock; ruff check . clean; ruff format --check . clean; mypy app/config.py app/observability/logging.py clean; pytest tests/unit/test_config.py tests/unit/test_logging.py 10 passed; import app exits 0. Added asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope=function to pyproject to silence the pytest-asyncio deprecation warning.
